candidates.name: Relocate one machine
candidates.assumption: Incremental play uplift triangular(-10%,20%,60%); floor retention triangular(25%,50%,100%). Destination not yet chosen; exploratory candidate.

candidates.name: Replace a machine with a leased new title

candidates.name: Add one technician to a shift for 30 days
candidates.target: One additional shift; roster to select
candidates.assumption: Recovers 10%-60% (mode30%) of historical downtime opportunity scaled to 23 July days; assumes one shift can cover this opportunity.

candidates.name: Preventive maintenance sweep for one manufacturer
candidates.assumption: Recovers 20%-80% (mode50%) of manufacturer downtime; planned 90 minutes per machine deducted.

candidates.name: Wayfinding and signage refresh for a zone
candidates.assumption: Zone play uplift triangular(0%,2.5%,8%); retained incremental floor play 25%-100%. Observational location differences are not causal effects.

candidates.name: Change comp redemption rate floor-wide
candidates.target: Floor-wide: proposed 12 points per comp face-value dollar
candidates.assumption: Proposed rate12 (catalogue range5-20); savings0%-25% (mode10%) and loss of expected gaming earnings0%-0.2% (mode0.05%) are assumptions, not proven effects.

candidates.name: Comp policy pilot with control group
candidates.target: Randomized pilot with unchanged total comp budget
candidates.assumption: Information-only test; no immediate benefit or additional comp spend credited. Cannot combine with floor-wide change.

limitations: Effects are assumed, not causal estimates. Probabilities are conditional on assumptions.
Simulation concerns theoretical contribution, not realized payout profit.
Common demand scenarios are used for all portfolios; shocks are bootstrapped independently by day.
Search is exhaustive only within this limited candidate list and conservative overlap exclusions.
Information value is unpriced; information-only actions may be worthwhile beyond 30 days.
Moving/replacement/signage targets require location and operational feasibility checks before implementation.

downtime.method: Machine-by-weekday operating-day hourly wager rate, 25th/50th/75th percentiles; machine/global fallback. Historical machine opportunity, not net floor loss or confidence interval.
